purpose: Decide whether a strict Vanadium alternate-branch input table may be created from the currently captured evidence.

decision.reason: The current evidence can support branch design and source-acquisition planning only. It is not source-complete for an Allen-Dynes strict row or an Eliashberg diagnostic contract.

field_readiness.strict_branch_issue: Primary-page confirmed, but still needs to be paired with a compatible branch formula family before strict use.
This is a Debye-temperature-style normal-state fit value, not an Allen-Dynes omega_log or omega2 moment.
No source-captured logarithmic phonon moment is present for Vanadium.
No source-captured second phonon moment or justified moment ratio is present for Vanadium.
The numeric capture is explicit but comes from a different source family and still needs compatibility review against the branch formula convention.
Multiple mu-star conventions are present and no branch-specific convention decision has been made.
No source-declared equation, kernel convention, or reproduction target has been captured for a Vanadium Eliashberg diagnostic.
The existing non-mirrored acceptance is scoped to the Nb3Sn PhysRevB.27.1568 Allen-Dynes branch, not Vanadium.

strict_unblock_requirements: Capture Vanadium omega_log_K and omega2_sqrt_K_or_ratio from a compatible source family, or capture an explicit Eliashberg equation or reproduction contract.
Resolve whether the open-fulltext lambda_ep=0.91 and mu_star=0.173 or 0.15+/-0.03 conventions are compatible with the chosen branch.
Record a Vanadium-specific non-mirrored or archive policy decision before strict branch evidence release.
Only after the above, create vanadium_alternate_branch_source_labeled_inputs.json and a separate Vanadium branch verifier artifact.

claim_boundary.allowed_now: Use this gate to explain why the Vanadium alternate branch is blocked at source-complete input construction.
forbidden_now: Do not create a strict Vanadium branch PASS artifact from the current fields.
Do not treat Theta_D_K_or_proxy_context as omega_log_K.
Do not move Vanadium out of the raw McMillan gate.
Do not patch the raw McMillan working row from this gate.

next_controller.controller_name: Vanadium omega_log/omega2 or Eliashberg equation contract capture
next_controller.shortest_next_action: Find or capture a source-backed Vanadium omega_log/omega2 pair, or an explicit Eliashberg equation/reproduction contract, before creating the branch input table.
